en: Black‑and‑white view of a lakeside or pond with trees framing the scene and the water reflecting the buildings opposite. In the background stands a substantial late‑19th‑century building with a mansard‑like roof, gabled ends, and arched ground‑floor windows. A group of people is lined up in front of the entrance. On the façade, German text advertising a concert or ball hall is visible. To the left is a timber‑framed house partly obscured by trees and a fence.
